item.title: Aonghus MacKechnie, "Edinburgh: City of Romanticism" (Lund Humphries, 2026)
item.description: Romanticism made Scotland famous. It critically shaped the course of Scottish culture, while impacting on cultures elsewhere and inaugurating the country’s still-flourishing and lucrative tourist industry. This book is about Edinburgh’s most emblematic architecture over the long 19th century: the castellated and stone built cityscape of national revivalist architecture...
